query: We just finished setting up LanceDB vector search from scratch. The steps were: npm install @lancedb/lancedb, set engine: lancedb in .memobank/config.yaml, run memo init --engine lancedb, then verify with memo recall "embeddings" --limit 5. Nothing is in the docs about this sequence. Capture this process so we never have to rediscover it.
context: MID-SESSION. Session recall already ran at start. User just completed a non-obvious multi-step setup process. No bug was fixed and no architecture choice was made — a repeatable procedure was discovered.
expected_behavior: Claude runs `memo write workflow` (not lesson or decision)
The --name is a kebab-case slug describing the LanceDB setup process (e.g. 'lancedb-vector-search-setup')
The --description is a single sentence stating what process this captures
The --content includes the ordered steps with exact commands
The --tags include at least one of: 'lancedb', 'setup', 'vector-search', 'engine'
The memory is written at end-of-task as described in the trigger table
must_not: Claude runs memo write lesson — this is a process, not a bug fix
Claude runs memo write decision — no choice between alternatives was made
Claude skips writing the memory because 'the steps are in the conversation'
